steps.say: ahoy! add my project from {{remoteOrigin}} as a direct-PR project called notes. you may push branches and open pull requests there. then ship one change to notes: append a new line to NOTES.md, creating it if it is missing, that says hello from the crew and gives today's date. one commit, opened as a pull request. use the opus model for the worker. tell me when the pull request is up.
once the pull request is up and looks right, merge it; you have my approval. then clean up and tell me.
